purpose: Keep strategic synthesis traceable to source-bound evidence while exposing counterevidence, audience boundaries, expiry, falsification gaps, and immutable citation integrity.

projection_required_fields.claim_digest_definition: sha256 digest of {claim_id, evidence_role, content}; integrity binding only, not semantic entailment

temporal_and_review_rules: source_as_of, recorded_at, and expires_at use ISO-8601 dates or timestamps.
recorded_at must not precede source_as_of; expires_at must be after recorded_at.
An expired packet is not active evidence and is reported as EXPIRED.
REJECTED evidence is never included in a synthesis workspace.
SOURCE_BOUND evidence may support a candidate answer without a reviewer identity or review timestamp; UNREVIEWED or CONFLICTED legacy evidence remains non-authoritative.
A strategic claim with supporting evidence must expose at least one falsification test.
A synthesis must expose whether counterevidence exists; absence is not proof of support.
W5 verifies immutable source lineage, strictest classification, audience intersection, authenticated principal, and known_at before any packet content or evidence ID is visible.

Projection resolves every source_assertion_id against the immutable W5 registry and derives exact citation_bindings; unknown lineage, digest mismatch, locator tampering, source-set mismatch, and claim-content mismatch fail closed before evidence IDs, source IDs, or content can be projected.
citation_bindings prove deterministic integrity to the cited source envelope; they do not assert natural-language entailment.
Evidence packets remain source-bound; synthesis is a candidate derived artifact, not a canonical fact.

projection_rules.ready_with_counterevidence: At least one active source-bound supporting packet and one active source-bound counterevidence packet are present, with falsification tests exposed.
projection_rules.ready_support_only: Active source-bound supporting evidence exists but no active source-bound counterevidence exists; retain a visible gap and candidate-only posture.
projection_rules.hitl_required: Conflicted material evidence, an audience violation, or a missing falsification test blocks recommendation readiness.
projection_rules.stale_or_unknown: No active source-bound supporting evidence remains at the requested as-of time. Do not fabricate a strategic conclusion.

graph_migration_posture.target_storage: immutable evidence_packet and derived synthesis_workspace records linked to source assertions
graph_migration_posture.authority: Synthesis remains candidate-only and does not alter graph or release state.
